name: Electron
notes: Lightest charged matter particle. Wave-like at lab energies — basis of electron microscopy.

name: Proton
notes: Nucleon. Roughly 1836× heavier than electron, so wave behavior shows up only at very low speeds.

name: Neutron
notes: Thermal neutron speed (≈2200 m/s) gives wavelength ~0.18 nm — perfect for crystal diffraction.

name: C₆₀ buckyball
notes: Largest object whose quantum interference has been observed (Zeilinger group, 1999).

name: Baseball
notes: Major-league fastball ≈ 40 m/s. de Broglie wavelength is ~10⁻³⁴ m — utterly undetectable.

name: Rifle bullet
notes: Rifle round ≈ 10 g at ~800 m/s (a 9 mm handgun round is ~400 m/s). Still vastly classical.
